svg.aria-label: Entity mono-repo folder structure: ingestion, transformation (dbt), orchestration (Dagster), infra (Terraform), docs, and root config files.
svg.text: One dbt project, one Dagster project, one Terraform module — per entity. Hover a top-level folder for detail, click to jump to the section that explains it.

g.title: SAP (and other source) extraction — the ADF pipeline definitions or fallback scripts. See "Extraction — SAP to cloud".
The dbt project — staging, intermediate, dimensions, facts and marts. See "Data layers".
Dagster project scheduling the ingestion and dbt assets. See "Orchestration — Dagster OSS".
A thin root module and the VM bootstrap script — the module code itself lives in terraform-azure-data-platform. See "Everything in Terraform".
Root module only — backend config, provider alias, a pinned call into terraform-azure-data-platform's entity and governance modules, and this entity's .tfvars. See ADR 0011.
Entity-specific operational notes — not a copy of this standards site. See "Onboarding an engineer".

g.text: ← operational procedures specific to this entity

g.title: Python dependencies, pinned — installed with `uv sync`, never an ad hoc `uvx dbt`. See "Local dev setup".

svg.text: Ingestion, dbt, Dagster and Terraform live together per entity — a schema change and its dbt impact are one commit, not synchronized PRs.
Governance content (naming, tagging, landing zones) is never copied here — it's linked from this repo's README.md instead.
This whole tree itself comes from the data-platform-entity-template GitHub template, not written by hand per entity — see ADR 0011.
